facts.business: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited manufactures precision materials such as thermostatic bimetal and trimetal strips, low-ohmic shunt resistors, electrical contacts, and specialized joining technologies, and is progressing towards integrated component and assembly solutions for automotive electronics, smart metering, current sensing, switching, battery management systems, and energy management.
key_risks: Assessment of liabilities under newly enacted labour codes (Code on Wages, 2019, Industrial Relations Code, 2020, Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020, Code on Social Security, 2020) involving significant management judgement and estimation regarding applicability, timing, interpretation, and potential incremental liabilities.
Contingent liabilities and capital commitments estimation involving reasonable degree of assessment by management.
facts.related_party_note: Fixed deposits pledged with Indian Bank as security for an overdraft facility sanctioned to its Wholly Owned Subsidiary, namely 'Shivalik Engineered Products Pvt.Ltd.'
